## Context / immutable basis
At origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84, five observability regression modules contain 72 audited prose blocks that repeat incidents, narrate assertions, or use decorative banners. Condense only those blocks while retaining the non-obvious operational and oracle contracts. Citations below identify immutable before-source; implement from current origin/main.

## Exact allowlist — 72 blocks
A stable ID is path::owner-or-leading-text@base-lines. Only these blocks may change.

- tests/scripts/test_observability_container_layers.py (20): module docstring@1-31; _share_bytes@68-69; _df_rows@93-98; comments beginning systemctl is-active@142-143, A heredoc@153-155, A reaper is in force@170-171, and The reaper units are absent@184-185; section banners The readings@249-251, Silence@309-311, and The heartbeats@342-344; docstrings for test_the_writable_layer_size_and_the_exited_subset_are_both_published@257-258, test_the_percentage_is_measured_against_the_share_the_reaper_holds@266-268, test_a_share_overrun_publishes_its_true_ratio@278-282, test_the_metrics_are_dimensionless_on_the_publishing_side@293-295, test_an_unmeasurable_writable_footprint_publishes_nothing@325-326, test_a_two_column_rendering_still_publishes_the_total@334-335, test_the_reaper_heartbeat_publishes_on_every_tick_including_its_zero_path@351-354, test_the_reaper_heartbeat_is_published_even_when_the_daemon_is_gone@361-363, test_the_quota_reading_reports_the_regime_the_box_is_actually_in@373-376, and test_the_probe_never_reaps@383-385.

## Preserve
Retain the distinct byte-set, silence-versus-zero, unclamped-budget, independent-reading, dimension, heartbeat, and bounded-probe contracts. Keep executable statements, assertions, parameters, runtime stub strings, decorators, and directives byte-equivalent. Preserve concise prose outside the allowlist, including _df_rows in docker_storage, _environment in journal/var_tmp, the two short pct_of_cap test docstrings, numeric-case comments, and the var_tmp timeout-stub comment. No allowlisted docstring has a discovered __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer.

## Independent review
A non-author reviewer records one TSV row per edited stable ID: path, stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, retained_contract, before_words, final_words, semantic_preservation, bloat_removal, reviewer_session. Both verdicts must be PASS, every final count must be smaller, and exactly 72 rows must exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 72 allowlisted blocks change.
- [ ] Adjacent blank-line changes occur only next to an edited block.
- [ ] Every edited block has `final_words < before_words` in the reviewer TSV.
- [ ] Every edited block has `semantic_preservation=PASS` in the reviewer TSV.
- [ ] Normalized Python AST and runtime content match the immutable basis after removing only allowlisted owner docstrings.
- [ ] Directive-bearing physical lines retain their original bytes and statement attachment.
- [ ] `HEAD^..HEAD` changes exactly the five declared paths.
- [ ] One ticket comment contains exactly 72 TSV data rows with these columns: `path<TAB>stable_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>retained_contract<TAB>before_words<TAB>final_words<TAB>semantic_preservation<TAB>bloat_removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every TSV before citation uses `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84:<path>#<stable-id>`.
- [ ] Every TSV final citation uses `<40-character-final-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `bloat_removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records a non-empty `reviewer_session`.
- [ ] All seven structured verification commands exit 0.

## Verification
Run the structured verification command in this ticket at verify_commands[dd_id=immutable-prose-only] with rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c; it contains the exact owner and base-span allowlists above and rejects AST, runtime-string, directive, or out-of-span hunk drift. Run the structured ticket-comment check at `verify_commands[dd_id=review-tsv]`; it rejects a missing, incomplete, non-reducing, or non-PASS reviewer TSV. Then run:
- rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest -q tests/scripts/test_observability_container_layers.py tests/scripts/test_observability_docker_storage.py tests/scripts/test_observability_journal.py tests/scripts/test_observability_pct_of_cap_b380.py tests/scripts/test_observability_var_tmp.py
- rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py
- rtk git diff --name-only HEAD^..HEAD
- rtk git diff --check HEAD^..HEAD -- tests/scripts/test_observability_container_layers.py tests/scripts/test_observability_docker_storage.py tests/scripts/test_observability_journal.py tests/scripts/test_observability_pct_of_cap_b380.py tests/scripts/test_observability_var_tmp.py
- rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify
